hero.title: Data understanding starts with understanding people.
hero.subtitle: Cognitive intelligence for BI and decision support.
body: CogniCheck helps BI professionals improve the full dashboard trajectory: from requirements and assumptions, to blueprinting, to cognitive analysis of reports.

sections.title: What CogniCheck supports
body: CogniCheck supports the full BI design process, from early requirements to dashboard improvement.

cards.title: Requirements & assumptions
cards.body: Turn vague dashboard requests into clearer decision questions and expose hidden assumptions early.

cards.title: Requirements to blueprint
cards.body: Translate business needs into a practical BI blueprint with metrics, data sources, risks and next steps.

cards.title: Cognitive report analysis
cards.body: Review dashboard screenshots using attention, structure, working memory and cognitive load principles.

cards.title: Decision support
cards.body: Improve the link between data, interpretation and action so dashboards support real decisions.

sections.title: Why this matters
body: BI teams often deal with ineffective dashboards, scattered data, weak KPIs, dashboard chaos and conflicting sources of truth.
CogniCheck helps create clarity by making assumptions, requirements, cognitive load and decision context more explicit.

sections.title: How CogniCheck works
body: A simple workflow helps teams move from vague dashboard needs to clearer, more useful decision support.

sections.title: Built on cognitive psychology
body: CogniCheck uses cognitive psychology principles to reduce cognitive overload and improve dashboard understanding.

cards.title: Attention
cards.body: Make the most important information stand out so users know where to look first.

cards.title: Structure
cards.body: Group related metrics clearly so users can understand the dashboard faster.

cards.title: Working memory
cards.body: Reduce mental effort by showing answers directly instead of forcing users to calculate them.

cards.title: Change visibility
cards.body: Make comparisons, deviations and trends visible so action becomes easier.

sections.title: Try CogniCheck in a demo
body: Use the demo password to access the analysis tools and test the dashboard review flow.

sections.title: Workshops and training
body: CogniCheck is also available as a workshop or training concept for BI teams, controllers, analysts and dashboard developers.
list: From report builder to trusted advisor

sections.title: About CogniCheck
body: CogniCheck was created by Robin Groen, a BI analyst with a background in psychology, management and data analytics.
The project started from a simple belief: good BI is not only about data. It is about helping people understand complexity and make better decisions.

sections.title: Interested in a demo, pilot or workshop?
